svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · COMPUTE-COMMUNICATION OVERLAP & SM GOVERNANCE (#367)
TransformerEngine Userbuffers (TMA) vs. FSDP2 Async vs. NCCL SM Contention
Preventing NCCL from stealing 28/132 SMs eliminates GEMM wave-quantization slowdown and lifts MFU to 57.4%
Tier 2 Trap: Naive NCCL Overlap Steals 28/132 SMs
• Default NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS=32 hijacks 28 SMs for packet copy
• 128-tile GEMM no longer fits on remaining 104 SMs -> 2nd Wave!
• L2 cache & HBM bandwidth contention degrades GEMM by 21.5%
• Net Exposed Overhead Still 14.5% (Cluster MFU Capped at 46.2%)
Tier 4: Userbuffers + TMA Copy Engine + NVLS
• Hardware Copy Engine (CE / TMA) + NVSwitch NVLS uses <=2 SMs
• Leaves 130/132 SMs for GEMM: zero wave-quantization penalty
• 0.8% Exposed Comm Overhead & 57.4% Effective Cluster MFU
4-Tier Compute-Communication Overlap Matrix (H100 132 SMs · TP=8 + FSDP2)
Tier 1 (Sequential No Overlap) : Comm SMs = 32 | GEMM Slowdown = 0.0% | Exposed Comm = 32.0% | MFU = 38.5%
Tier 2 (Naive Multi-Stream NCCL) : Comm SMs = 28 | GEMM Slowdown = 21.5% | Exposed Comm = 14.5% | MFU = 46.2%
Tier 3 (FSDP2 Async + NVLS 6-Chan) : Comm SMs = 6 | GEMM Slowdown = 4.2% | Exposed Comm = 4.2% | MFU = 53.8%
Tier 4 (Userbuffers + TMA + NVLS) : Comm SMs = 2 | GEMM Slowdown = 0.8% | Exposed Comm = 0.8% | MFU = 57.4%
